description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Nagawila (Block 04), Pallama D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No.410264 (25/120008)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land and property-related matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in various villages in Puttalam District under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title settlement procedures, and determinations of land title - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
